comment: No family is given for the four signal inputs: a scope shows whatever is patched into it, and the CV-or-audio button changes only how the trace is drawn, not what the jack expects. The volts-per-division steps and their names are at Scope.cpp:90 to :110; the time base spans ten to the power of -5 to 0 seconds a division and the holdoff ten to the power of -4 to 1 seconds (Scope.cpp:35 to :38). The AC coupling filters have a 0.1Hz corner. Two parameters, DEBUG_1 and DEBUG_2, are declared but their controls are commented out (Scope.cpp:292, :293), so no click can reach them. At Scope.cpp:275 the trigger output is registered with configInput rather than configOutput; since both enums start at zero this writes the name onto the channel A input and leaves the output unnamed, which the entry notes. The statistics readout skips the external trigger when it is showing only the trigger channel (Scope.cpp:2006).
